moments.title: Commonwealth Games concludes in Glasgow

angles.name: Closing Ceremony Buzz

angles.copy: It's the penultimate day of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow today, with a massive 44 golds up for grabs! How are our home nations shaping up on the final medal table?
